item.title: 'For the Love of the Mansion' event showcases the stories of Louisiana
item.description: BATON ROUGE - People gathered at the Old Governor's Mansion on Sunday to learn and listen during the "For the Love of the Mansion" event.&nbsp;The free educational event showcased a ballroom dancing class, an afternoon cello recital and an exclusive look into the museum's archives.&nbsp;"We always encourage people to be tourists in their own city and come visit us. item.title: Crash on I-12 Eastbound near Amite River leaves interstate closed
item.description: DENHAM SPRINGS &mdash; Authorities are currently responding to a crash on I-12 Eastbound near the Amite River that has left the interstate closed.The crash occurred around 6 p.m. on Sunday, leaving one vehicle upside down and the interstate closed in that area.The crash has caused traffic to back up to O'Neal Lane.Drivers in the area should use caution or plan an alternate route.Permalink| Comments

item.title: High school students host pet food drive to benefit Companion Animal Alliance
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; People stopped by the University Laboratory School at LSU on Sunday to drop off food for dogs and cats at a pet food donation drive.The event, led by high school students from across the capital area, gathered donations to benefit the Companion Animal Alliance.On Tuesday, volunteers will transport the food to Companion Animal Alliance, which will distribute donations to the community.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
